moni.quest.08948A23B3A17923.description1: &bLaserIO&r's energy cards can be upgraded with &6Energy Overclockers&r to allow them to transport energy. &eNote that only the extracting card requires an overclocker!&r
moni.quest.09C0CDC1DFA7842D.description1: &2Pumps are useful for gathering Oil or perhaps Lava from the Nether.
moni.quest.0C10EC03A01E7334.description5: The exact implementation is up to you. Make use of the various LV and MV machines you have, and look through &bEMI&r and the Renewable Production tab for the ways to get infinite sources of each ingredient (like &aEnderman Models&r for pearls).
moni.quest.05F7C3F397B329F5.description1: With two &9IV &6Energy Hatches&r on a &3Large Chemical Bath&r, you are now able to break down &6Rarest Metal Mixture&r, which you have been getting from your pre-existing Platline.
moni.quest.0E9B96B17D140B99.description1: Also known as PEEK, this plastic will be used for coating cables of &4UHV&r+ voltage and as an incredibly fast item pipe.
moni.quest.1175ED9EF0AB82F6.description7: &9Building Gadgets can be bound to the ME system by &8Shift-right-clicking&9 with it on an online ME Wireless Access Point.&r
moni.quest.1229234A71CE0A99.description1: &6Redstone&f: Found only deep in the world, in massive veins paired with &6Cinnabar&f and &6Ruby&f.
moni.quest.19084E91F357C8C2.description2: (Unique multi mechanic code taken from the Cosmic Frontiers team with Caitlynn's gracious permission.)
moni.quest.193B7038EAB6EFA3.title: &9Gregtech Rocketery
moni.quest.1BC6DDC2D50F9C46.description2: Since smelting &6Aluminium&r requires MV power, you're going to have to power this with 2 LV Energy Input Hatches.
moni.quest.1C861E0C62D5B97D.description2: (Unique multi mechanic code taken from the Cosmic Frontiers team with Caitlynn's gracious permission.)
moni.quest.1E36AFB19932C805.description2: If you haven't made it already, you will need &6Polyethyl Cyanoacrylate&r.
moni.quest.38B1588655AA9BDF.description2: Shattered microverses cannot be repaired in any way. To run more missions, you must re-shatter a Normal microverse. When a Shattered microverse reaches 0% Integrity, it becomes a &3Corrupted Microverse&r.
moni.quest.3B3F46345D39CAE2.description3: The dusts need to be &2bathed in Hydrochloric Acid to make Tungstic Acid, then electrolyzed&r to get to the Tungsten, which then needs to be cooked in the EBF for Tungsten Ingots.
moni.quest.431BB650AC492C84.title: &9 Machine Auto-Output
moni.quest.485CEA4199AAD352.description3: HASoC chips grant access to cheaper &6Wetware Processors&r, but require a &3Circuit Assembler&r running &4UHV&r voltage.
moni.quest.4C0BCA64D5B409F2.description2: With this you can make &aUEV &6Energy Hatches&r, unlocking the &3Dimensonal Superassembler&r, &3Transdimensional Energy Singularity&r, and the most efficient recipe for &6Optical Circuits&r using &6Photonic SoCs&r.
moni.quest.5911900438648430.description1: As the most advanced polymer you will need to make, &6Polyethyl Cyanoacrylate&r is required for a few endgame crafts.
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description1: Unlike &aRF power&r, which is safe to transport with &bLaserIO&r, &aEU power &erequires caution&r. The key is to always &amatch or exceed&r the &eVoltage &rand&e Amperage&r of your power source with your &6cables&r and machines.
Transporting &aEU power &erequires caution&r. The key is to always &amatch or exceed&r the &eVoltage &rand&e Amperage&r of your power source with your &6cables&r and machines.
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description2: &cNEVER &rhook up your Energy Converter&r to a cable that has fewer &eAmps&r than your Energy Converter or Battery Buffer generates. For example, you must use &64x cable&r for a 4A Converter&r, and &616x cable&r for a filled 16-slot Battery Buffer&r. Cables with insufficient amperage rating will &cburn and be destroyed&r.
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description3: Similarly, your cable must match or exceed the &eVoltage&r of your machines, or they will &cburn and be destroyed&r.
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description4: &cNEVER&r connect a machine to excessive &eVoltage&r or it will &cvaporize&r. Touching a &6wire&r with connected &aEU power&r will &cinjure or kill you&r, so for your safety, &euse &6cables&e instead&r!
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description5: &2Superconductor-type wires do not damage you in GTm. The 0-loss wires (Conductive Iron, Energetic Alloy, etc.) are considered Superconductors.
moni.quest.634E056463ED1532.description2: This alloy is cooked in an &3Electric Blast Furnace&r and cooled in a &3Vacuum Freezer&r.
moni.quest.6DC635766CD40FFF.description2: With these coils, you can now smelt &6Tantalum Carbide&r, required for the &3Alloy Blast Smelter&r.
moni.quest.70784021A2D4E520.description1: &6Wrought Iron&r is a better alternative than &6Iron&r for tools, and with the &3Alloy Smelter&r you finally have a way to manufacture it, albeit slowly.
moni.quest.70784021A2D4E520.description2: First, you put Iron Ingots the &3Alloy Smelter&r with a &6Nugget Mold&r to create Iron Nuggets. Those Nuggets are then smelted in any &3Furnace&r to create &6Wrought Iron Nuggets.&r
moni.quest.70784021A2D4E520.description3: Finally, you can turn those &6Wrought Iron Nuggets&r into a &6Wrought Iron Ingot&r with another trip to the &3Alloy Smelter,&r or by &3Macerating&r them, combining the dust piles and another round of smelting in a &3Furnace.&r
moni.quest.74A7ABF43D6A403F.description2: It is important to note that if you do not have the required hatches, the Terminal will leave holes for those hatches, causing the multiblock to not form.
moni.quest.75810A27FBBBFB77.description3: Naquadah Chemistry yields large amounts of a variety of valuable resources. It will serve as your primary source of radioactive elements such as &6Neptunium&r, &6Curium&r, and &6Berkelium&r, as well as providing quite a bit of other advanced materials such as &6Tritanium&r, &6Darmstadtium&r, and &6Neutronium&r.
moni.quest.3E1A349F989835F7.description1:
It is easier to explain how &6Photonic SoCs (PSoCs)&r work in text rather than visually.

Imagine each PSoC has three on/off levers for the Red, Green, and Blue colors.
moni.quest.3E1A349F989835F7.description2: When a PSoC is put into the Crucible, the lever(s) corresponding to the Crucible's colors are toggled. Secondary colors flip both of their primary components' levers. Afterwards, the Crucible changes color to what the PSoC previously was.
